summary: Commonwealth of the Bahamas. Parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a commonwealth realm.
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor-General Cynthia A. PRATT (since 1 September 2023); Prime Minister Philip Edward DAVIS (since 17 September 2021)
government: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm
economy: high-income tourism and financial services economy; major income inequality; strong US bilateral relations; several tax relief programs; targeted investment in agriculture, energy, light manufacturing, and technology industries GDP (PPP): $14.544 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Royal Bahamas Defense Force (RBDF): includes land, air, maritime elements; Royal Bahamas Police Force (RBPF) (2025) Expenditure: 0.7% of GDP (2024 est.)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
